requirements.title: Current market evidence snapshot
requirements.requirement: Market simulation archetypes must be anchored to current manufacturer documentation where factual product characteristics are used, with retrieval date and source URL recorded.

requirements.title: Exactly 450 deterministic combinations
requirements.requirement: The design simulation must deterministically produce exactly 450 scenario combinations from the tracked source catalog at an exact source SHA.

requirements.title: All 27 processes covered
requirements.requirement: Every ELV5 process CCTV-01..06, LAN-01..07, ACS-01..06 and FA-01..08 must have non-zero market-simulation coverage.

requirements.title: Priority core receives deeper stress
requirements.requirement: CCTV-02, CCTV-03, LAN-01, LAN-05, ACS-03, ACS-04, ACS-05, FA-02, FA-04, FA-05 and FA-06 receive approximately double the scenario density of non-core processes.

requirements.title: All P0-P9 packages represented
requirements.requirement: The generated matrix must demonstrate how scenarios traverse the relevant P0-P9 contracts, and aggregate coverage must include every package P0 through P9.

requirements.title: Five vector classes per process
requirements.requirement: Every process must include POSITIVE, BOUNDARY, NEGATIVE_OR_UNSUPPORTED, ADVERSARIAL and CROSS_DISCIPLINE market scenarios.

requirements.title: Vendor fact versus synthetic fixture separation
requirements.requirement: Manufacturer facts, market-derived envelopes and synthetic test values must be separately labelled; synthetic values may not be represented as vendor specifications.

requirements.title: Engineer error-prevention taxonomy
requirements.requirement: Every generated scenario must identify the primary engineering error class Electra is expected to prevent or expose and the package/process layer that catches it.

requirements.title: Actionable remediation projection
requirements.requirement: Simulation output must identify a stable remediation direction or downstream owner instead of presenting unexplained PASS/FAIL prose.

requirements.title: No normative or procurement overclaim
requirements.requirement: Market simulation validates technical design behavior only; it must not convert current product examples into jurisdictional compliance, certification or ELV8 SKU/BOM procurement decisions.

requirements.title: Deterministic generation version
requirements.requirement: Scenario IDs, distribution, factor selection and expected dispositions must be deterministic under a versioned generation algorithm; random unseeded matrices are prohibited.

requirements.title: Exact-head simulation artifact
requirements.requirement: CI must generate and publish a machine-readable market-simulation artifact with source SHA, authority fingerprint compatibility fields, counts, package coverage, process coverage and error-class coverage.
